dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Reliability - SLI and SLO
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for backend availability, latency, error-free requests, freshness, burn signals, and SLO target review. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: SLI and SLO
pages.description: Backend service-level indicators and initial production targets.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS false) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE duration <= 0.75) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS false) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE workflow.feedRefresh.ageSeconds <= 900) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS false), percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE duration <= 0.75), percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(workflow.feedRefresh.ageSeconds), percentile(workflow.feedRefresh.ageSeconds, 95) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT 100 - percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS false) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Definitions and targets live in docs/newrelic-service-levels.json. Review after seven stable production days.
